answer: The admission bond is time locked for 15 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in harbor, expire in canyon, and lotus lists each expiry. An adversary running 85 aliases therefore needs 167 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4959 identities would post 4324 proofs and burn roughly 39 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
